DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。入力で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any trouble entering the information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込先の支店番号が〇二三ですが、入力は二三になりました。先頭のゼロを消してよい数字なのか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 〇二三の支店番号を二三と入力し先頭ゼロ省略可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient's branch number is 023, but I entered 23. I want to check whether the leading zero is one I may leave out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may omit the leading zero after entering branch number 023 as 23.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込先の控えにも〇二三とありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your copy of the recipient's details also say 023?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三桁で〇二三です。金額の数え方のように、ゼロは不要だと思って省きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控え三桁なのに金額同様の不要ゼロと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it has three digits, 023. I left out the zero because I thought it was unnecessary, as when writing an amount of money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that although your copy has three digits, you treated the zero as unnecessary as in an amount of money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 識別する番号は、表示された桁も含めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For an identification number, please check the number of digits shown as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 〇二三で入力し直します。ただ、入力欄が自動で表示を変えるかは分からないので、案内も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三桁へ直し欄の自動表示仕様も案内で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll enter it again as 023. However, I don't know whether the field automatically changes the display, so I'll also check the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct it to three digits and check the instructions about the field's automatic display behavior.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確定前に、案内された支店名との一致も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before confirming, please also check that the branch name given matches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支店名が控えと違えば、番号を推測して進まず係員へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えと支店名不一致なら番号推測で続けず相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the branch name differs from my copy, I won't guess the number and continue. I'll consult a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that if the branch name differs from your copy, you will ask for help rather than continue by guessing the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check it in that state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えの三桁と支店名を照合します。金額のゼロと同じ扱いで省かず、確認後に確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 桁と名を照合し金額同様にゼロ省略せず確定すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll compare the three digits and branch name with my copy. I won't omit the zero as if it were an amount of money, and I'll confirm only after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will compare the digits and name, keep the zero rather than treat it like a monetary amount, and then confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。入力の案内をお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll help you with the entry instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you find a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さきほどの試食と同じ味のスープがほしいです。この大きい袋と小さい袋は、味が同じで量だけ違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食味スープ大小袋が同味量違いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like soup with the same flavor as the sample I just tried. Do this large bag and small bag have the same flavor, with only the quantity differing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the large and small bags of the sampled soup have the same flavor and differ only in quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の商品名を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the product names on the bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は同じですが、小さい方は一人分の個包装、大きい方は一袋にまとめて入っているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名は同じで個包装一人分と大袋まとめの差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The names are the same, but the small one seems to have individually wrapped single servings, while the large one has everything together in one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the names match, but one has individually wrapped single servings and the other has the contents together in a large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使い方の単位も確認しましょう。何人で、いつ使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check the portion units. How many people will use it, and when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で何日かに分けて使います。総量だけでなく、開ける単位が小さい方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で別日に使うため総量でなく開封単位を重視すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use it alone on several different days. I want to choose based on having smaller units to open, rather than just the total amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that because you will use it alone on separate days, you care about the amount opened each time rather than the total quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個包装の数と、一包で作る量を表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the label for the number of packets and how much one packet makes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは三包です。一袋を一度に三人分と思っていましたが、一包ずつ使えるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三包を一度に三人用でなく一包ずつ使えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This has three packets. I thought the whole bag had to make three servings at once, but I can use one packet at a time, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether the three packets can be used one at a time rather than all at once for three people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示された作り方と保管の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the preparation and storage instructions shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三包の小さい方にします。同じ味でも使う単位が違うので、個包装数を確認して買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と包数で三個包装商品を購入すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the smaller one with three packets. Even with the same flavor, the usable portions differ, so I'll check the number of individually wrapped packets before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will check the label and packet count and buy the product with three individually wrapped portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらの商品で会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take this product to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。読書のご利用でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your reading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた本の気になる所へ印を付けたいです。鉛筆なら消せると思いましたが、書く前に記録する方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸出本へ消せる鉛筆印を付ける前に記録方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to mark places of interest in a borrowed book. I thought pencil could be erased, but before writing, I'd like advice on how to keep notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to keep a record before marking a borrowed book with erasable pencil.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出しの本には直接書かず、ご自身の紙に記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not write directly in borrowed books. Make notes on your own paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。言葉とページ番号を私の手帳へ写します。消せることを理由に書き込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本へ書かず手帳に言葉ページを記録すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll copy the words and page numbers into my notebook. I won't write in the book just because the marks can be erased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will record words and page numbers in your notebook rather than write in the book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ページを折って目印にすることも避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also avoid folding pages to mark them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 折らずに、今のページを手帳へ残します。貼ってはがす物も、使う前に案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折らず記録し貼付物も使用前に案内確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't fold them; I'll record the current page in my notebook. Before using anything adhesive that can be peeled off, I'll check the guidance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the page without folding it and check the guidance before using adhesive items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返す前に、私物の紙などが挟まっていないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before returning it, please check that your own papers or other belongings aren't left between the pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、しおりは自分の物なので回収します。借りた本と一緒に手帳を渡さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却前に私物しおりを取り手帳も渡さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the bookmark is mine, so I'll take it out. I'll make sure not to hand over my notebook with the borrowed book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will remove your own bookmark before returning the book and avoid handing over your notebook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な記録は取れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you made all the notes you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 言葉とページを記録しました。書込みや折り目を付けず、私のしおりを取って本を返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録済みで無書込無折目の本をしおり回収後返すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've recorded the words and pages. I'll return the book without writing or folded corners, after removing my bookmark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that your notes are complete and you will remove your bookmark and return the book without writing or folds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらで返却を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We can accept the return here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。時刻表をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the timetable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この便は九時三分と九時八分が並んでいます。二本の列車なのか、同じ便の到着と出発なのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 九時三分八分が二列車か同一便着発か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This service lists 9:03 and 9:08 side by side. Could you tell me whether these are two trains or the arrival and departure of the same service?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether 9:03 and 9:08 refer to two trains or the arrival and departure of one service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の着と発をご覧ください。同じ便の二つの時刻です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the arrival and departure labels. They are two times for the same service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時三分着、九時八分発ですね。友人には九時三分に出ると伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着三分発八分を読み友人へ三分発と誤伝達したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it arrives at 9:03 and departs at 9:08. I've already told my friend it leaves at 9:03.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the 9:03 arrival and 9:08 departure and explain in Japanese that you mistakenly told your friend it leaves at 9:03.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発車の予定と到着の予定を区別してお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the planned departure from the planned arrival when telling them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ発車は九時八分と訂正します。ただ、ぎりぎりで間に合うと考えず、早めに乗り場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発八分へ訂正し余裕を持ち乗り場へ行くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll correct the departure time to 9:08 for my friend. Still, I won't assume I can arrive at the last moment; I'll go to the platform early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will correct the departure to 9:08 and go to the platform with time to spare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用する日と便の欄もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the date and the column for the service you will use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の欄です。同じ数字がほかの列にもあるので、列を途中で移って読まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日便の列を読み同数字で別列へ飛ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is today's column. The same numbers appear in other columns, so I'll take care not to switch columns partway through reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will read today's service column and not jump to another column because of identical numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の運行案内にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also pay attention to the current service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ便の着発として読み、日付と運行案内を確認します。二本の列車として選び直す必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同便着発と日付現運行を確認し二本と誤って選び直さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read them as the arrival and departure of the same service and check the date and service information. So I don't need to choose again as if there were two trains, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the same service's arrival and departure, date and current operation, without mistakenly choosing again as if there were two trains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの乗り場案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please also see this platform guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談票をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the consultation form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職種の欄に正社員と書きましたが、雇用形態の欄もあります。営業の仕事をしているので、どちらへ何を書くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 正社員と書いた職種欄と雇用形態欄の区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote permanent employee in the occupation field, but there's also an employment type field. I work in sales, so I'd like to check what to put in each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the difference between the occupation field where you wrote permanent employee and the employment type field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雇用形態は正社員、仕事の種類は営業ということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your employment type is permanent employee, and your kind of work is sales?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。正社員だから事務職と同じ意味だと思っていましたが、仕事は新しい客先への営業です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新規営業で正社員を事務職の意味と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought being a permanent employee meant the same thing as office work, but my actual work is sales to new clients.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you work in new-client sales and misunderstood permanent employee as meaning office work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 仕事の内容と雇用形態を分けて記載しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's write your work duties and employment type separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職種は営業に直し、仕事内容には新規の客先訪問と書きます。雇用形態は正社員です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職種営業仕事内容新規訪問雇用正社員と分け記載する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll change my occupation to sales and write visits to new clients under duties. My employment type is permanent employee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State in Japanese separately: sales for occupation, visits to new clients for duties, and permanent employee for employment type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先の業種は、さらに別の情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your employer's industry is another separate piece of information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の業種まで私個人の職種と混ぜないようにします。分からない表記は会社の資料で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社業種を本人職種と混ぜず資料で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll avoid mixing up the company's industry with my own occupation. I'll check company documents for any wording I'm unsure about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not confuse the company's industry with your occupation and will check the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容を確認してからご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the contents before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 営業、正社員、会社の業種を別に整理します。一つの言葉で全てを説明したつもりにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職種雇用業種を別々に整理して提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll organize sales, permanent employee and the company's industry separately. I won't assume one word explains all of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will organize occupation, employment type and industry separately before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。各欄を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check each field together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。診察前のメモをお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your notes before the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜に咳が出ることを、ときどきと書きました。今週は三晩だったので、日付で伝えた方が正確だと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ときどきという咳メモを今週三晩の具体記録で伝えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote sometimes to describe my nighttime cough. It happened on three nights this week, so I think giving the dates would be more accurate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to replace the vague cough note sometimes with the specific record of three nights this week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの日だったか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember which days they were?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月曜、水曜、土曜です。毎日ではありませんが、一度だけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月水土で毎日でも一度だけでもないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. It isn't every day, but it wasn't just once either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it was Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, neither every day nor just once.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その三晩をメモへ残して、担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please note those three nights and tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。月曜と水曜は寝る前、土曜は夜中に起きた時です。三回とも同じ時刻とは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 月水就寝前と土曜夜中で同時刻としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. On Monday and Wednesday it was before bed, and on Saturday it was when I woke up during the night. I won't write that all three happened at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that Monday and Wednesday were before bed and Saturday was during the night, so you won't describe them as the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 覚えている時間と、分からない時間を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please separate the times you remember from those you don't know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 土曜の正確な時刻は不明です。携帯を見ていないので、後から時刻を作って加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 土曜正確時刻不明で後から時刻を作らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know the exact time on Saturday. I didn't look at my phone, so I won't make up and add a time afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that Saturday's exact time is unknown and you will not invent a time afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 症状の意味は診察の担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss the meaning of the symptoms with the clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三晩の日付と覚えている時間を示します。ときどきという言葉だけで、回数や時刻が伝わったと思わず説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三晩の日付と分かる時間を示し曖昧頻度語だけで伝達済みにしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the dates of the three nights and the times I remember. I'll explain them rather than assume that sometimes alone communicates the frequency and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the three dates and known times, without treating a vague frequency word as a complete explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。そのメモを担当へお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show those notes to the clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。道案内でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with directions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅へ行く道を、一つ目の信号で曲がると聞きました。でも信号のない細道で曲がってしまったので、今の場所から行き直す道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つ目信号を信号なし細道と誤解して現在地から駅への修正道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to turn at the first traffic light on the way to the station. But I turned into a narrow street without a light, so I'd like to know how to get back on course from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to correct your route to the station from your current position after mistaking a narrow street without lights for the first traffic light.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何を一つ目として数えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you count as the first one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発した店の隣の細道です。信号がある交差点ではなく、見えた道を一本と数えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店隣の細道を最初の道と数え信号条件を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The narrow street beside the shop I started from. I counted the first street I saw, rather than an intersection with traffic lights.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you counted the narrow street beside the shop as the first road and overlooked the traffic-light condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の案内は、信号を目印に数えています。今の場所をこの案内図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The original directions count traffic lights as landmarks. Let's check your current location on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この交番へ来る前に、小さな橋を渡りました。出発した店へ戻るべきか、ここから進めるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋を渡った現在地から戻るか進めるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I crossed a small bridge before coming to this police box. I'd like advice on whether I should return to the shop I started from or can continue from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to go back or continue from your current location after crossing the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図で現在地と駅を確認して、通れる道をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check your location and the station on the map and show you a passable route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。元の案内の一つ目を、今この交番からの一つ目へ勝手に置き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の一つ目を今の交番起点へ勝手に置換しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I won't arbitrarily reinterpret the original first one as the first one starting from this police box now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will not change the starting point of the original first one to the current police box on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい案内では、どこから何を数えるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the new directions, please check where you start and what you count.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この交番を出発点にして、示された信号と曲がる方向を確認します。細道の本数だけで判断せず進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新起点信号方向を照合し細道本数だけで進まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use this police box as the starting point and check the indicated lights and turning direction. I won't proceed based only on the number of narrow streets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will verify the new starting point, traffic lights and direction, rather than proceed by counting narrow streets alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの図で道をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you the route on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。宛名のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help addressing something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の担当者へ送ります。会社名の御中と人の名前の様を両方付けましたが、重ねてよいのか見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社御中と担当者様を両方付けた宛名の敬称を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending it to a contact at a company. I added both onchū after the company name and sama after the person's name. Could you check whether using both is correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the address honorifics after adding both company onchū and contact sama.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当者のお名前が分かっているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You know the contact person's name, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、会社の営業部の佐藤さんです。会社にも人にも丁寧にしたくて、両方書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 営業部佐藤へ送るため丁寧さで二敬称にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's Mr. Sato in the company's sales department. I wanted to be polite to both the company and the person, so I wrote both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you used two honorifics out of politeness when writing to Sato in the sales department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個人を宛名にするなら、その方への様で書き、御中と重ねません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: When addressing an individual, use sama for that person and do not combine it with onchū.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社名と営業部は残して、最後を佐藤様とします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社部署を残し個人宛佐藤様へ直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll keep the company name and sales department and finish with Sato-sama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will keep the company and department and change the individual addressee to Sato-sama.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送付先の住所や部署名もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the destination address and department name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資料の営業部という名前をそのまま使います。佐藤さんの自宅へ送る意味ではなく、会社で受け取る宛名です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社営業部正式名で職場受取宛で自宅宛でないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the sales department's name exactly as it appears in the documents. This is addressed for receipt at the company, not for sending to Mr. Sato's home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the official company sales department name and address it for receipt at work, not at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した表示を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can check the rewritten address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社名、営業部、佐藤様と並べ、御中様とはしません。送付先も会社の資料で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社部署個人様と住所確認で敬称を重ねず発送すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll list the company name, sales department and Sato-sama, without writing onchū-sama. I'll also check the destination in the company documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the company, department, individual sama and address, without doubling honorifics before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛名を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me look at the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。貯蓄のご相談をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with your savings question?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行用に四万円を用意したいです。一万円はもうあり、残りを四回で貯めたいので、全額をまた割らず計算したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目標四万円既存一万円で残額を四回に分ける計算を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to set aside 40,000 yen for a trip. I already have 10,000 yen and want to save the rest in four installments, so I'd like to calculate without dividing the full amount again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to divide the remaining amount into four installments when the goal is 40,000 yen and you already have 10,000 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しく用意するのは、残りの三万円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the new amount you need is the remaining 30,000 yen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一回一万円だと思いましたが、それでは既存の一万円と合わせて五万円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新規各一万円だと合計五万円となる誤計算を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought it was 10,000 yen each time, but that would total 50,000 yen including the 10,000 yen I already have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the miscalculation that adding 10,000 yen each time would make the total 50,000 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残り三万円を四回なら、一回七千五百円という計算です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dividing the remaining 30,000 yen into four gives 7,500 yen each time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 七千五百円ずつの計画をメモします。これは商品の利息などを含む計算ではなく、自分で貯める額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残三万円各七千五百の自己積立計画で利息含みではないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note the plan to save 7,500 yen each time. This is the amount I'll save myself, not a calculation including interest on a financial product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that the remaining 30,000 yen will be saved personally at 7,500 yen each time, excluding interest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際の積立手続きは、時期や条件も確認して相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For an actual savings arrangement, you can also discuss the timing and terms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月を含む四回です。初回に一万円をもう一度入れる予定ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今月含む四回で既存一万円を再投入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The four installments include this month. I'll explain that I don't plan to put in the existing 10,000 yen again with the first installment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the four installments include this month and you will not pay in the existing 10,000 yen again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の分と、今後の予定を区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish what you already have from your future plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 既存一万円と予定四回各七千五百円で目標四万円と説明します。手続きの条件は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存額と四回予定の目標計算を示し手続条件は別確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that my existing 10,000 yen plus four planned installments of 7,500 yen reaches the 40,000 yen goal. I'll check the procedural terms separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the goal calculation using the existing amount and four future installments, and check procedural conditions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご希望の時期も一緒に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll also ask about your preferred timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スイカを買いたいです。半分なら冷蔵庫へ入ると思いましたが、棚の高さが低いので、切った形も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スイカ半分が低い冷蔵棚に入るか切形を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy watermelon. I thought half would fit in my refrigerator, but the shelf is low, so I'd also like advice about the shape of the cut pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether half a watermelon will fit on a low refrigerator shelf and discuss the cut shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 置く場所の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the dimensions of the space where you'll put it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 棚の高さは十五センチです。幅はありますが、半分を立てると高さが足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚高十五で幅あるが半分直立は高さ不足かもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shelf height is 15 centimeters. There's enough width, but there may not be enough height if I stand a half upright.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the shelf is 15 centimeters high and wide enough, but an upright half may be too tall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場にある切り方と、商品の実際の大きさを見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at the available cuts and the products' actual dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四分の一の商品も見たいです。丸い状態の直径だけでなく、包まれた状態で置けるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四分商品と包装状態実寸を見たいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like to see the quarter pieces. I'll check whether it fits when wrapped, rather than just the diameter of the whole round fruit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you want to see quarter pieces and their actual dimensions when packaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの二つを比べられます。何人で召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare these two. How many people will be eating it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人です。大きさだけでなく食べる量も考え、一番大きい物にこだわりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人分の食量も考えて最大サイズに拘らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two. I'll consider how much we can eat as well as the dimensions, instead of insisting on the largest one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider the amount for two people and will not insist on the largest size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品を選んだら、表示の保管方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've chosen a product, please also check the storage instructions on its label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 高さと食べる量が合う四分の一を選びます。半分なら必ず入ると決めず、形と表示を確認して買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 形高さ量が合う四分を表示確認後購入すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose a quarter that suits both the height and the amount we will eat. I won't assume a half will definitely fit; I'll check the shape and label before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the label and buy a quarter whose shape, height and quantity suit your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらの商品で会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take this product to the checkout.
